description: Archipelago velvet — Colore: Mediterranea & copper Collezione: Lucis Codice: 1A05136 Materiale: 9% Cashmere, 91% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 139.5 cm Rapporto: 46.5 cm × 25 cm Toni: Blue-green, Blue, Green ARCHIPELAGO is a luxurious textile available as printed velvet or cotton, featuring a design inspired by the silhouettes of islands significant to Fortuny's history. Its scattered and irregular composition creates movement through distribution rather than repetition alone, lending the fabric an expansive, landscape-like quality. The pattern is particularly well-suited to expansive walls, statement drapery, and oversized upholstery where it can unfold fully. Finished with Fortuny's proprietary metallic pigments, applied by hand in the Giudecca factory on a cashmere-cotton ground . Part of the LUCIS Collection .
